transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. Welcome in—what brings you here today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Well, what made me finally ask for help is that I barely want to eat anymore. Like, I'll be on my lunch break at the store, just staring at food I used to really like, and I end up just throwing most of it away. I just don't have an appetite at all lately.
How long have you been experiencing this loss of appetite—days, weeks, or longer?

It's been going on for about two months now. I guess it started right after I got this window display award at work, and, you know, getting all that attention from the district manager. That's when I really stopped wanting to eat.
Over these past two months, have you been feeling down, sad, or empty most of the day, nearly every day?

Not really, no. I mean... I wouldn't say I feel sad or down. I haven't really noticed feeling empty, either. I just... I don't know, it's mostly just that I don't have any interest in eating. But I don't think I've been feeling sad like that.
Besides your appetite, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yeah, actually, I have. I used to get really excited about things like going to gallery nights, playing basketball, or grabbing food-truck tacos with my friends. I even liked helping kids with art stuff on the weekends. But lately... I just don't care about any of it. When I do try to go out, I just stand there feeling totally flat. I usually end up making some excuse so I can just leave early.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight loss over these two months, or other physical symptoms like fatigue, night sweats, or pain?

I haven't noticed any night sweats or pain, and I don't think I've lost weight... I mean, my clothes fit about the same. But I have been really tired. By the middle of a shift, my body just feels heavy. Even doing basic stuff, like straightening the clothing racks or walking back to the stockroom... it just takes way more out of me than it should.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep over these past two months, like trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, I have. Most nights I just lie there in bed, replaying this award thing and different conversations from the store in my head. And then... if I actually do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way too early. Once I'm awake, I just can't get my mind to shut back off, so I'm stuck just lying there.
Have you ever had a period like this before—weeks or more of low interest, fatigue, or sleep problems—at any earlier point in your life?
No, I haven't. I mean, everyone has bad days, but... nothing like this. I've never felt this tired or had this much trouble sleeping for weeks on end before. This is all pretty new for me.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you would be better off not being alive, during this time?
No, I haven't. I mean, I feel really drained and... just down, but I haven't had any thoughts about dying or not being here. Nothing like that.
Since the award and the extra attention at work, have you been feeling especially nervous, worried, or on edge about your job performance or expectations?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel nervous or worried about the job itself. It's just... I'm tired all the time and everything feels like it takes so much effort now. But it's not like I'm anxious about my performance or what they expect from me.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making everyday decisions over the past two months?

Yeah, I have. At work, I keep... I keep losing my place on really simple stuff. Like if I'm counting inventory or just picking out colors for a display, I'll just lose track of what I'm doing. And then I end up second-guessing myself over little decisions that I used to make fast. It's just harder to focus on it all right now.
